Limited explicit review revision of the current unexecuted artifact. Preserve accepted requirements and public interfaces EXACTLY, every existing business operation and its arguments, visited-product ordering, both ID validation steps, writer, root cleanup, current bounds and permissions. No redesign or new consent work. Correct only the following data-adaptation tasks and their immediate references/guards. Return the revised TaskPlan for separate approval.

1. projectSearchRecordsByPage must be a PURE foreach, not transform/extract. Keep its identity and position, iterate field(output(openSearchPage, observationSnapshot), pages), maxItems 100, empty body.tasks, and export records = field(item, records). This preserves the complete original typed producer records, with no learned copying, invented key, changed requiredness or inference. Keep output(records) as array<array<OriginalRecord>>. scrapeProductPages.items remains lookup(flatten(output(projectSearchRecordsByPage, records)), output(projectVerifiedCandidateIds, id)), but its identity port must be selector, the ORIGINAL record identity. Candidate key is an exact observed selector value, never a synthesized key/hash/index; make extractCandidateArrays objective explicit about copying selector to key and observed text to decisionText. Offered-candidate lookup still uses key and preserves repetitions. Do not add a nested record loop or recreate original records.

2. extractProductFactArrays currently requires synthesized scalar labels field='name'/'description'/'price'. Source-grounded mapping cannot invent these classification labels. Replace only its resultType with nonnullable object {facts: nonnullable array(maxItems 100) of nonnullable objects with required nameFacts, descriptionFacts, priceFacts, each a nonnullable array(maxItems 200) of nonnullable observed strings}. each remains {input:pages,output:facts}, one result per original page; empty arrays reflect examined absence. Copy only observed scalar data, no fabricated labels/nulls/errors. Update interpretProductRecord.inputs.facts to output(extractProductFactArrays,facts) DIRECTLY, not flatten: facts now is array<object>. Keep its other inputs and non-null product/nullable missing-field outputs unchanged. Real interpretation may reconcile these compact facts, while exact source URLs remain direct bindings.

3. Local requires BEFORE both page extractions and before the pure original-record projection must check original acquisition success=true, observationSnapshot != null, captureTruncated=false and manifestTruncated=false, short-circuiting the null check before any field access. Use the same full original-metadata checks for interpretProductRecord and selectTopOfferedCandidateIds. Do not replace assertions with model flags, silently skip work or admit incomplete observations. Preserve existing URL non-null guards. Missing/invalid source fields still fail.

4. In scrapeProductPages.body.outputs.row, bind url directly to field(item,href), not interpretProductRecord.url; name/description/price/errors remain from the compact reconciliation. On finalErrors add requires equal(output(saveWorkbook,success),true) so failed writing stops before successful public output publication and root cleanup still runs. Keep filePath/fileSaved from writer outputs and all public contracts unchanged. No other task, objective, output, guard or operation changes. Use only the issued schema, existing typed bindings and explicit scopes; no scripts, fabricated data or new constructs.
